en.headline: Route 6 full opening this year will cut Tseung Kwan O to Yau Ma Tei to 12 minutes
en.dek: Transport chief Mable Chan said the Central Kowloon Bypass Kowloon Bay section is on track to complete in 2026, linking the whole 12.5 km strategic route.
body: Secretary for Transport and Logistics Mable Chan said the remaining Central Kowloon Bypass (Kowloon Bay section) is expected to finish within 2026, completing Route 6 and cutting peak-hour travel between Tseung Kwan O town centre and Yau Ma Tei from about 65 minutes to roughly 12 minutes.

In a blog post on Saturday, Chan said the 3.4 km Kowloon Bay section will connect eastward to the Tseung Kwan O–Lam Tin Tunnel and westward to the already-opened Yau Ma Tei section, forming the full 12.5 km trunk road that links Yau Ma Tei, Kai Tak and Tseung Kwan O, with interchanges at Kai Tak and Lam Tin.

She noted that more than 100 traffic contingency plans have been prepared, including 165 covering the entire Route 6 and 70 specific to the Kowloon Bay section. Transport Department has coordinated with franchised bus operators so that 20 routes will use the new corridor once it opens, improving links between east and west Kowloon and Tsuen Wan.

zh.headline: 6號幹線今年全線通車 將軍澳至油麻地料減至12分鐘
zh.dek: 運輸及物流局局長陳美寶指中九龍繞道九龍灣段料今年內竣工，全線12.5公里貫通後繁忙時段車程大幅縮短。
body: 運輸及物流局局長陳美寶表示，中九龍繞道（九龍灣段）工程預計今年內完成，屆時將東連將軍澳—藍田隧道、西接中九龍繞道（油麻地段），貫通整條6號幹線。全線通車後，繁忙時段往來將軍澳市中心與油麻地的行車時間，將由約65分鐘大幅減至約12分鐘。
陳美寶周六在網誌指出，6號幹線全長12.5公里，開通後以一條主幹道連繫油麻地、啟德及將軍澳多個核心地段，並在啟德和藍田設有交通交匯處。九龍灣段長約3.4公里。
她得悉部門已制定過百個交通預案，包括涵蓋整條6號幹線的165個預案，以及專為九龍灣段而設的70個預案。運輸署已與專營巴士營辦商協調，通車後將有20條專營巴士路線使用該幹線，方便往返東九龍、西九龍及荃灣等地。
